integrity: The norm constant and Schur input inequalities are cited from the 2026 primary source; the quantitative concentration defect is obtained by an independent positive-kernel estimate. Numerical checks confirm identities only in sampled parameters; general proof is analytic.
scientific_limitations: The explicit stability coefficient is not known to be optimal. Pole concentration is necessary, not sufficient, for extremality; the division of mass between poles is not classified. Only the sharp-constant range is treated.
title: Quantitative antipodal concentration for sharp alpha-harmonic Riesz–Fejér traces
